news.headline: Seahawks are hurting with injuries, but two players will return vs. Raiders
news.description: QB Drew Lock will start again for Darnold. And LB Uchenna Nwosu and WR Rashid Shaheed will return to the field in Las Vegas.

news.headline: Vikings to start reacquired QB Kirk Cousins vs. Packers

news.headline: 49ers OT Williams, LB Greenlaw questionable, WR Evans out vs. Cowboys

news.headline: When will Lamar Jackson return to the field?

news.headline: NFL outlines steps in Jalen Hurts investigation in letter to senator
